text.p: Asset Plus Securities Co Ltd on Thursday said K.R. Precision Plc has peaked and recommended investors buy shares when they fall to about 163 baht ($6.27) for long-term investment.
"KRP's stock price has already surged 14 percent since the beginning of this year, already reflecting much of the upside," Asset Plus said in a research report.
K.R. Precision shares were down 3.0 at 171 baht at 0810 GMT.
Asset Plus said it expected K.R. Precision's total annual sales in 1996 to rise 11 percent to 917 million baht.
It said the company's third plant was expected to start in May, just in time to support the rise in demand.

"Assuming KRP's market share in the world suspension assembly market increases from 1996's 13 percent to 14 percent and 15 percent, respectively, in 1997 and 1998, we forecast a sales growth of 31 percent, and 26 percent for KRP in those years," Asset Plus said.
KRP's fair value should be around 192 baht, it said.
"We would be looking to buy the stock at around 163 baht where the upside will be at least 15 percent," it said.
